method: Exactly two fresh sequential native GPT-6.1 Sol reviewers, fork_turns:none, neutral briefs. Normal URL and visible-driver help/protocol plus own UI only. Defaults. No code edits or post-review tuning/rescore.

anchors.1: Observed experience obstructed or unclear most of the time
anchors.3: Coherent playable slice with meaningful unresolved friction
anchors.4: Consistently strong across the observed portion, only localized friction
anchors.5: Exceptional consistency and refinement across the observed portion; does not imply certification

rating_scale.scope: Scores assess only this reviewer’s observed slice. AAA readiness score is an observed production impression, not a release certification.

gameplay.reason: Optic kills, movement, recovery rewards and staged boss objectives create a functioning combat loop; both runs ended in death with extensive exposed holds and aim misses. Synthetic controls limit feel judgments.

presentation.reason: Strong graphic hierarchy and coherent storm-lit palette; simple repeated geometry and enemies limit richness. Audio not evaluated.

usability.reason: Readable main actions, map and explicit close-range correction support progress; handbook density and initially distant ineffective holds slowed learning.

readability.reason: Bright enemy optics and numbered boss status are legible, but inert/active surface alignment, overlapping markers and threat pressure remained difficult to parse while moving.

AAA readiness.reason: The observed slice has cohesive direction and complete death/redeploy flow, but limited environmental and character detail and unresolved navigation/combat onboarding friction do not support a high premium-production impression. Ending, audio and hardware remain unassessed.

outcomes.summary: Killed induction guard, navigated west, missed moving sentinel while aiming, failed two distant holds, recovered Mara after moving closer, died under patrol pressure during attempted dash/reload defense.

Improved deliberate optic shooting. Repeated Mara range failures, cover/pillar blocks and route corrections before eventual recovery. Recovered Sera first, Mara second, Elian third. Found Custodian by routing around hall walls; destroyed coil 1, damaged coil 2, then fired into inert coil 1 after moving. Crouch/reload intervals did not prevent flanking damage. Final lateral dash and reload/fire attempt ended in death.

observed: lateral Soul Shift inputs and cooldown
Custodian armored/open phases, coil 1 destruction, coil 2 partial damage
not_observed: successful phase evade or charge interruption
uncertainties: Some Space inputs may have jumped rather than vaulted; no animation timing certification.
Threat indicators did not establish precise damage source for every hit.
No general balance conclusion follows from two synthetic attempts.

anchors.1: Observed experience repeatedly prevents basic play
anchors.2: Functional core with substantial friction in observed play
anchors.3: Coherent playable slice with meaningful limitations
anchors.4: Strong execution across observed situations with minor friction
anchors.5: Exceptional execution across broad observed coverage

rating_scale.qualification: Scores are judgments from these two losses, not certification or a target; unobserved systems do not receive inferred credit.

gameplay.rationale: Functional recovery-to-boss escalation, critical induction kill and two disabled coils. Persistent patrol pressure creates stakes, but my combat and route control were brittle; no full mission completion.

presentation.rationale: Consistent storm station art direction, atmospheric reflections and typography; visible geometry remains spare/blocky. Audio not evaluated.

usability.rationale: Clear deploy/redeploy, map and recovery reach feedback; dense handbook and repeated failed route choices leave onboarding improvement room.

readability.rationale: Large objectives, optic/coil color coding and physical numerals communicate well; small layered text and direction cues demanded attention under fire.

AAA readiness.rationale: Promising coherent vertical slice with working progression and retry, but these two losses do not establish final encounter/extraction quality, breadth, accessibility, audio, performance or production robustness. Observed navigation and HUD density still introduce friction.

outcomes.custodian: Coils I and II visibly OFF; III 100% at last playing capture. Defeat not achieved.
outcomes.trajectory: Induction critical kill; west archive recovery; unsuccessful Heart hold at 6m, another at 3.2m / 0.4m outside reach; small step and recovery; east recovery; architecture corrections while returning south; two coils disabled; died while reloading/repositioning for third.

Induction critical kill; attempted east route instead of west. Long movement met walls repeatedly. Two E holds out of reach recovered nothing. Corrections returned near central entry, losing health under patrol fire. Selected breacher but fired only during final push; died before meaningful weapon comparison.

observed: Rifle ADS/fire/reload and induction critical elimination
One lateral Soul Shift during first attempt and final push Shift in second; no recorded evade
Three memory recoveries and two out-of-reach Heart holds
Patrol fire, directional warnings, shield regeneration and health loss
Custodian activation and two disabled numbered coils
Breacher selection and brief terminal firing
